# Mem0 Alternatives — How to Compare Memory Systems

Evaluate Supermemory, Zep, Letta, Cognee and a custom memory stack against your data, lifecycle, hosting and migration requirements.

By Dhravya Shah, Founder and CEO·4 min read

For the numbers side by side, including an independent benchmark that ran both, see supermemory vs Mem0. For the longer write-up, read how supermemory and Mem0 compare on features.

The right Mem0 alternative depends on the requirement your current setup does not meet. Compare retrieval behavior, data sources, authorization, deployment and total cost using a representative workload. This comparison is published by Supermemory and covers documented capabilities as of September 18, 2026.

## Start by describing the problem [...] ## Start by describing the problem

Write down a failing case rather than a feature label. Examples include a corrected preference returning its old value, a document arriving too late for the next answer, or an application being unable to prove which user may read a memory.

Mem0 Platform documents multimodal inputs, memory expiration and background lifecycle processing. A local open-source installation and the hosted Platform are different products to evaluate.

## Five approaches worth evaluating

### Supermemory

Supermemory provides document ingestion, extracted memories, search and user profiles. Its documentation explains how these pieces connect. # ChatGPT Memory Alternatives: 9 Options Compared (2026)

Switching assistants trades one memory wall for another, while a cross-tool layer follows you into every AI you use.

ChatGPT memory works, but only inside ChatGPT, and mostly with what you've typed there. The right alternative depends on why you're leaving: move to Claude, Gemini, Perplexity or Copilot and you get another app's built-in memory with the same walls, or add a cross-tool layer such as Unabyss, MemoryPlugin or Basic Memory and one memory follows you into every assistant.

Nine options below, checked on each vendor's own pages in October 2026.

## Why look for a ChatGPT memory alternative? [...] | Tool | Works in | Memory comes from | Can you see and edit it? | Price (checked October 2026) |
------
| ChatGPT memory (for reference) | ChatGPT only | Your chats, saved memories, custom instructions; files and Gmail on Plus and Pro outside the EEA, UK and Switzerland | Edit the memory summary; delete saved memories | Free; Go 8/mo,Plus20/mo |
| Unabyss | Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and 8 more MCP clients; Markdown exports for the rest | Your work apps: Gmail, Calendar, Notion, Slack, GitHub, Linear and 20 more | Yes, in one place, with per-app and per-file control | 7-day free trial, no card; Pro 15/mo;Max89/mo |
| Claude memory | Claude only | Your Claude chats, saved as topics, separate per project | Yes, every topic | Free; Pro 20/mo,Maxfrom100/mo | [...] ## FAQ

### What is the best alternative to ChatGPT memory?

For one other assistant, Claude's memory, because you can read and edit every topic it keeps. For several assistants, a cross-tool layer: MemoryPlugin if your memory is your chats, Unabyss if it lives in Gmail, Calendar, Notion and Slack.

### Is there a free alternative to ChatGPT memory?

Yes. Claude's memory is on by default on its Free plan, Google's help center names no paid plan for Gemini's saved info, Basic Memory is free run locally, and a context file costs nothing.

### Which AI chatbot has the best memory?

ChatGPT has the most automatic memory, Claude the most transparent, and Gemini the deepest link to your Google data. None of them shares memory with the others.
